0=成功；非 0 时 msg 里有飞书的报错: 0=success; when non-zero, msg contains Feishu's error
Markdown，转换规则同 docx_create: Markdown, using the same conversion rules as docx_create
Markdown：# 标题 / 列表 / 代码块 / 引用会转成对应文档块，其余: Markdown: # headings / lists / code blocks / quotes are converted into matching document blocks, everything else becomes a paragraph
URL 里 table= 后那串（tbl…）: The string after table= in the URL (tbl…)
docx_create 的产出，或文档 URL 里 docx/ 后那串: The output of docx_create, or the string after docx/ in the document URL
om_ 开头；回复/撤回都认它: Starts with om_; used for both replying and recalling
om_ 开头；来自事件或发送操作的产出: Starts with om_; comes from an event or from a send operation's output
ou_ 开头；发消息用它: Starts with ou_; used for sending messages
ou_ 开头；可留空建空群: Starts with ou_; leave blank to create an empty group
text 消息的正文（已去掉 @bot 标记）；非文本消息为空: The body of a text message (with the @bot mention stripped); empty for non-text messages
上一批返回的 page_token: The page_token returned by the previous batch
上传图片换 image_key 并发送，两步包成一步: Upload an image for an image_key and send it — two steps bundled into one
上传图片换 image_key（发消息/卡片里引用）。一次上传可多次发送: Upload an image to get an image_key (for referencing in messages/cards). One upload can be reused across multiple sends
上传文件换 file_key 并发送，两步包成一步: Upload a file for a file_key and send it — two steps bundled into one
上传文件换 file_key（发消息里引用）: Upload a file to get a file_key (for referencing in messages)
不存在/不可见的用户；全成功时为空: Users that don't exist or aren't visible; empty when everyone succeeded
与 markdown 二选一；都填时用 markdown: Use either this or markdown; if both are filled in, markdown is used
与手机号至少填一个: Fill in either this or the phone number
以卡片形式渲染 Markdown（加粗/链接/列表/代码块/分割线）。工作流产出: Render Markdown as a card (bold / links / lists / code blocks / dividers). A natural fit for reports produced by a workflow
任意类型，≤30MB（更大走网盘上传）: Any type, ≤30MB (use Drive upload for larger files)
企业内的用户 ID；未授权时为空: The user's ID within the organization; empty when not authorized
列出 bot 已加入的群（拿 chat_id 用于发消息）: List the groups the bot has joined (get chat_id for sending messages)
创建群聊并拉入成员，bot 自动入群: Create a group chat and add members; the bot joins automatically
卡片头；留空则不带头: Card header; leave blank for no header
卡片表单收集的值（没有表单则为空），键名由卡片作者定义: Values collected from the card's form (empty if there's no form); keys are defined by the card's author
卡片里给按钮配的 value——用它区分点了哪个钮: The value configured on the button in the card — used to tell which button was clicked
发一条纯文本；可在文本里用 <at user_id=\"ou_xxx\"></a: Send a plain-text message; use <at user_id="ou_xxx"></at> in the text to mention someone, or <at user_id="all"></at> to mention everyone
发完整的交互卡片 JSON（按钮/下拉/表单）。按钮点击经「卡片按钮点击」事件回: Send a complete interactive card as JSON (buttons / dropdowns / forms). Button clicks come back into the workflow through the "Card button clicked" event
可存下来复用，免得重复上传: Can be saved and reused to avoid uploading again
同页的 App Secret。只在插件内部换 tenant_access_tok: The App Secret from the same page. Only used internally by the plugin to exchange for a tenant_access_token; never enters nodes or logs
在会话里回复某条消息（被回复的消息上方有引用）。message_id 通常来自「: Reply to a message within a conversation (the original message is quoted above the reply). message_id usually comes from the "Message received" event
在文档末尾追加 Markdown 内容（日报流水、持续记录类场景）: Append Markdown content to the end of a document (for scenarios like daily-report logs or ongoing records)
在飞书「卡片搭建工具」里拼好后把 JSON 粘进来: Build the card in Feishu's "Card Builder" and paste the resulting JSON here
如 CurrentValue.[状态]=\"待处理\"；留空取全部: e.g. CurrentValue.[Status]="Pending"; leave blank for all
开放平台「开发者后台 → 凭证与基础信息」里的 App ID（cli_ 开头）: The App ID from "Developer Console → Credentials & Basic Info" on the open platform (starts with cli_)
所在对话 ID: The chat ID it belongs to
把文件传到云空间的指定文件夹。与发文件不同：进网盘可长期存、可分享链接: Upload a file to a specific folder in Drive. Unlike sending a file, this stores it long-term and makes it shareable via a link
把用户拉进 bot 所在的群（bot 需有拉人权限）: Add users to a group the bot is in (the bot needs permission to add members)
把飞书接进工作流：发消息/卡片、收消息触发、写云文档、读写多维表格。: Bring Feishu into workflows: send messages/cards, trigger on incoming messages, write documents, and read/write Base records.
拉人者 open_id: The open_id of whoever added them
按 record_id 更新记录的部分字段（没提到的字段不动）: Update some fields of a record by record_id (fields not mentioned are left unchanged)
按条件查记录。需要 bitable:app 权限，且把多维表格分享给应用（添加为: Query records by condition. Requires bitable:app permission, and the base must be shared with the app (added as a collaborator)
按邮箱或手机号换 open_id（发私信前必经的一跳）。需要「通过手机号或邮箱获: Resolve an open_id from an email or phone number (a required step before sending a direct message). Requires the "Get user ID by phone number or email" permission
撤回 bot 自己发的消息（发出 24 小时内）: Recall a message the bot sent itself (within 24 hours of sending)
放进哪个文件夹（网盘 URL 里 folder/ 后那串）。留空放在应用自己的空: Which folder to put it in (the string after folder/ in the Drive URL). Leave blank to use the app's own space — **users can't see it in Drive there**, so this is usually required
新增一条记录。fields 键=字段名：文本填字符串、数字填数字、单选填选项名、: Add a new record. fields keys are field names: text takes a string, number takes a number, single-select takes the option name, multi-select takes an array of option names
新建一篇云文档（docx），可带初始 Markdown 内容。需要 docx:d: Create a new document (docx), optionally with initial Markdown content. Requires docx:document permission
用 app_id/app_secret 换一次 tenant_access_to: Exchanges app_id/app_secret for a tenant_access_token once and checks the bot's info — failing to get a token means the credential is invalid
直调任意开放平台接口（tenant_access_token 由插件管理）。ty: Call any open-platform API directly (the plugin manages the tenant_access_token). Use this for capabilities the typed operations don't cover
网盘 URL 里 folder/ 后那串。**必填**——应用空间里的文件用户看: The string after folder/ in the Drive URL. **Required** — files in the app's own space aren't visible to users
群聊填 chat_id（oc_ 开头）；单聊填对方 open_id（ou_ 开头: For a group chat, enter chat_id (starts with oc_); for a direct message, enter the recipient's open_id (starts with ou_) or email
表格 URL 里 base/ 后那串（bascn…）: The string after base/ in the table's URL (bascn…)
请求体 JSON，键名照飞书开放平台文档；本插件不介入: Request body JSON, with keys following the Feishu open-platform docs; this plugin doesn't interpret it
还有下一页时非空: Non-empty when there's a next page
键=字段名，值形状随字段类型（文本串/数字/选项数组…），由多维表格列配置决定: Keys are field names; the value's shape depends on the field type (text string / number / option array…), as defined by the base's column configuration
键=字段名，值按字段类型：文本→字符串、数字→数字、单选→选项名、多选→数组、日: Keys are field names, values follow the field type: text→string, number→number, single-select→option name, multi-select→array, date→millisecond timestamp; the shape is defined by the table's column configuration
键=字段名，值按字段类型；只更新提到的字段: Keys are field names, values follow the field type; only the mentioned fields are updated
飞书 card.action.trigger 的原始回调，形状由开放平台定义: The raw callback for Feishu's card.action.trigger, shaped as defined by the open platform
飞书 im.chat.member.bot.added_v1 的原始事件，形状由: The raw event for Feishu's im.chat.member.bot.added_v1, shaped as defined by the open platform
飞书 im.message.receive_v1 的原始事件，形状由开放平台定义: The raw event for Feishu's im.message.receive_v1, shaped as defined by the open platform and extended over time
飞书 lark_md 方言：**加粗**、[链接](url)、有序/无序列表、`: Feishu's lark_md dialect: **bold**, [links](url), ordered/unordered lists, `code`, and --- dividers
飞书应答的 data 字段，形状随接口而变，由开放平台文档定义: The data field of Feishu's response; its shape varies by endpoint and is defined by the open-platform docs
